checks.finding: REQ-001–REQ-014 have measurable outcomes or explicit decisions; AC-001–AC-034 provide corresponding planned oracles. The Phase-1/2 tuples, inventory and ownership checks, release-cycle evidence, rollback branches, and zero-friction result are specified concretely.
Each stated goal REQ-001–REQ-014 maps to one or more acceptance criteria AC-001–AC-034, including the separate criteria for advisory operation, promotion, rollback, and dogfood friction.

The acceptance criteria specify observable schema results, publication or activation rejection, emitted evidence, inventory/digest validation, CI execution, and recorded WFI outcomes. The acceptance artifact marks these as planned, not executed.

Requirements explicitly exclude later Pack types, replacement of existing foundation mechanisms, new UI/cloud/CI workflow, and creating or approving live artifacts during specification bootstrap. REQ-005 and AC-009 bound the first Pack.

The requirements state approval and protected-publication boundaries, dependency and shared-state preflight, cross-platform compatibility, ownership limits, and rollback authorization. REQ-009 also specifies zero-identity rejection and current-registry revalidation.

High-risk publication, enforcement, and rollback claims have planned validation surfaces: AC-002, AC-014–AC-018, AC-028, AC-033, and AC-034 cover approval, atomic promotion, evidence availability, signatures, cooldown boundaries, and registry changes.
